analyst_view.overall: A relegation six-pointer: Troyes are 17th with 8 points, Le Havre last with 2 and the only side without a league win after six straight defeats. Le Havre suspended Didier Digard after a 5-1 home loss to PSG, lost 2-0 to Lorient under interim Jair Karam, and have now appointed Valérien Ismaël until the end of the season; with the international break he has had about a week of training, and this is his first game. Troyes (Stéphane Dumont) have tightened up, with two clean sheets in three, but they rank last in Ligue 1 for big chances. Troyes' defender Diaz is listed as banned for yellow cards (the numbers count it), though one preview still names him in the lineup; Le Havre's injury list (Mpasi, Mambimbi, Zagadou out; Pembélé, Jelert doubtful) is in the numbers too. Referee Jérémie Pignard (4.4 cards a game) is already counted.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.3 goals, and they already count Diaz's ban for Troyes (+6% for Le Havre) and Ouzenadji's absence (-4.5% for Troyes). I lean lower (-4%), to about 2.2: Troyes create the fewest big chances in the league and have kept two clean sheets in three, and a new coach's first job at the bottom is usually to stop conceding, which points to a tight game. Sports Mole also expects a low score.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.7 corners, with Troyes' share at home (5.2) the bigger one; recent corner form on both sides is in the numbers. A new coach could change how Le Havre attack, but nothing yet shows how Ismaël will set them up after a week of training. I stay at about 8.7.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.8 cards, and they already add 17% for referee Jérémie Pignard (4.4 cards a game in 44 matches). I lean a bit higher (+5%), to about 5.0: this is a bottom-two six-pointer with a coach brought in as an emergency fix and a Troyes side six points clear of last, so both should play with extra edge, which the numbers' season-long view does not see.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.8 shots. Le Havre have been shooting a lot lately (107 in their last six) while losing every game, and Troyes create little; the numbers already count that recent form. A new coach could raise Le Havre's tempo or make them more cautious, and nothing points clearly either way, so I stay at about 24.8.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.7 shots on target. I lean slightly lower (-3%), to about 7.5, in line with goals: Troyes are last in the league for big chances, and a tense game between the bottom two with a new coach bedding in should produce few clear shots. Missing players on both sides are already counted.
